---
title: Footnotes inside callouts
format: html
_quarto:
  tests:
    html:
      noErrors: true
      ensureHtmlElements:
        - [
            # Numbered in document order: title, body ref, inline note,
            # then the paragraph after the callout.
            'div.callout-title-container a.footnote-ref[href="#fn1"]',
            'div.callout-body-container a.footnote-ref[href="#fn2"]',
            'div.callout-body-container a.footnote-ref[href="#fn3"]',
            'section#footnotes div#fn4',
          ]
        - [
            'span.quarto-note-reference',
            'section#footnotes div#fn5',
          ]
---

Regression fixture for bd-akkproqy. Since #1050 a callout stays a `Callout`
custom node until the crossref phase, so the footnote transforms that run
earlier must walk into its slots. Related cases: `callout-tabset-footnote.qmd`
(tabset in a callout) and `callout-code-filename.qmd` (code-block scaffold).

::: {#nte-x .callout-note}
## Title with a note[^t]

Body reference.[^b] Inline^[An inline note.].
:::

After the callout.[^a]

[^t]: Note T.
[^b]: Note B.
[^a]: Note A.
